metadata.description: Unified vulnerability report integrating multiple scanner outputs, categorized by host, port, severity, and enriched with CVE data.

vulnerabilities.name: Deprecated TLS Versions Enabled
vulnerabilities.description: The server supports deprecated TLS versions (TLS 1.0 and/or TLS 1.1).
vulnerabilities.solution: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1. Use TLS 1.2 or higher.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Header
vulnerabilities.description: The HTTPS server does not implement HSTS as per RFC 6797.
vulnerabilities.solution: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to responses.

vulnerabilities.name: Weak Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange (Logjam)
vulnerabilities.description: SSL/TLS uses Diffie-Hellman groups with modulus <= 1024 bits.
vulnerabilities.solution: Use DH groups with 2048+ bits or enable ECDHE.

vulnerabilities.name: TCP Timestamps Enabled
vulnerabilities.description: TCP timestamps are enabled, which may allow uptime estimation.
vulnerabilities.solution: Disable TCP timestamps in system configuration.

vulnerabilities.name: Weak Cipher Suites Supported
vulnerabilities.description: Server supports weak cipher suites (e.g., CBC-based in TLS 1.0/1.1).
vulnerabilities.solution: Disable weak cipher suites. Use AES-GCM, ChaCha20, etc.

vulnerabilities.name: Multiple Security Headers Missing
vulnerabilities.description: Missing security headers such as CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.

vulnerabilities.name: Potentially Risky HTTP Methods Allowed
vulnerabilities.description: PUT, DELETE, DEBUG methods are allowed, which could be misused.

vulnerabilities.name: SSL Certificate Mismatch
vulnerabilities.description: Certificate issued for demo.testfire.net, but accessed via testfire.net.
vulnerabilities.solution: Use a certificate that matches the accessed domain.

vulnerabilities.name: Swagger API Documentation Exposed
vulnerabilities.solution: Restrict access to API documentation in production.

informational_findings.details: Apache Tomcat/Coyote 1.1 detected on ports 80 and 8080.
TLS 1.2 and 1.3 supported, weak cipher suites present.
SSL certificate issued by Sectigo, valid until 2026-06-21.
Akamai nameservers, DMARC and SPF records present.

recommendations: Enable HSTS and other missing security headers.
Upgrade DH groups to 2048+ bits or use ECDHE.
Ensure SSL certificate matches the domain.
